mapper.select: SELECT id,code,name FROM platform ORDER BY id
SELECT id,code,name FROM platform WHERE code=#{code}
SELECT id FROM platform WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT state,platform_id AS platformId,user_id AS userId,creator_id AS creatorId,code_verifier AS codeVerifier FROM oauth_attempt WHERE state=#{state}
mapper.update: UPDATE oauth_attempt SET consumed_at=NOW(),code_verifier=NULL WHERE state=#{state} AND platform_id=#{platformId} AND consumed_at IS NULL AND expires_at>NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT id,creator_id AS creatorId FROM platform_account WHERE platform_id=#{platformId} AND external_id=#{externalId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO platform_connection(platform_account_id,authorized_by,access_token_encrypted,refresh_token_encrypted,token_expires_at,refresh_expires_at,granted_scopes,status) VALUES(#{accountId},#{authorizedBy},#{accessToken},#{refreshToken},#{tokenExpiresAt},#{refreshExpiresAt},#{grantedScopes},'CONNECTED') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE authorized_by=VALUES(authorized_by),access_token_encrypted=VALUES(access_token_encrypted),refresh_token_encrypted=VALUES(refresh_token_encrypted),token_expires_at=VALUES(token_expires_at),refresh_expires_at=VALUES(refresh_expires_at),granted_scopes=VALUES(granted_scopes),status='CONNECTED',last_error=NULL,updated_at=NOW()
mapper.sql: pc.id,pc.platform_account_id AS accountId,p.code AS platformCode,p.name AS platformName,a.creator_id AS creatorId,a.name AS accountName,a.external_id AS externalId,pc.authorized_by AS authorizedBy,pc.status,pc.last_synced_at AS lastSyncedAt,pc.last_error AS lastError,pc.token_expires_at AS tokenExpiresAt,pc.refresh_expires_at AS refreshExpiresAt,(pc.refresh_token_encrypted IS NOT NULL) AS refreshAvailable,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM platform_content content WHERE content.connection_id=pc.id) AS contentCount
FROM platform_connection pc JOIN platform_account a ON a.id=pc.platform_account_id JOIN platform p ON p.id=a.platform_id
pc.access_token_encrypted AS accessToken,pc.refresh_token_encrypted AS refreshToken,pc.granted_scopes AS grantedScopes
mapper.select: SELECT a.creator_id=#{creatorId} ORDER BY pc.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO platform_content(connection_id,external_id,title,description,cover_url,permalink,media_type,published_at,view_count,like_count,comment_count,last_synced_at) VALUES(#{connectionId},#{externalId},#{title},#{description},#{coverUrl},#{permalink},#{mediaType},#{publishedAt},#{viewCount},#{likeCount},#{commentCount},NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title=VALUES(title),description=VALUES(description),cover_url=VALUES(cover_url),permalink=VALUES(permalink),media_type=VALUES(media_type),published_at=VALUES(published_at),view_count=VALUES(view_count),like_count=VALUES(like_count),comment_count=VALUES(comment_count),last_synced_at=NOW(),updated_at=NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT c.id,c.connection_id AS connectionId,p.code AS platformCode,p.name AS platformName,a.name AS accountName,c.title,c.description,c.cover_url AS coverUrl,c.permalink,c.media_type AS mediaType,c.published_at AS publishedAt,c.view_count AS viewCount,c.like_count AS likeCount,c.comment_count AS commentCount,c.last_synced_at AS lastSyncedAt ORDER BY c.published_at DESC,c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
